annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the Question of Formalizing the Ethics of Collaborative Robot Behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on mechanisms enabling a collaborative robot to be a moral agent. It argues non-classical logics cannot fully formalize ethics, proposes utilitarianism with hedonistic axiology, uses cognitive maps, and states three principles of robot moral behavior. Abstract only; not a governance instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Logical schemes and non-classical logics cannot resolve formalization of moral doctrines given inherent contradictions and incompleteness.
Moral systems should provide an explanatory component justifying agent behavior.
Utilitarianism (Bentham, Mill) combined with hedonism proposed as ethical basis for robot behavior.
Robot behavior is determined by current needs and perception state.
Morality rests on comparing conspecifics with 'self' (own-alien degree).
